**

Lex&Mex in Tirol

** **

Discover the wild, untamed side of Tirol with Lex&Mex – where adventure meets authentic alpine culture. Whether you're seeking heart-pounding action or pure relaxation, Tirol’s rugged landscapes and vibrant cities offer the perfect playground.

** **

Adventure Awaits

** **

From the towering peaks of the Zillertal Alps to the crystal-clear waters of the Inn Valley, Tirol is a paradise for thrill-seekers. Try your hand at white-water rafting on the wild Ötztal rivers, conquer the legendary Nordkette above Innsbruck, or zip-line through the lush forests of the Lechtal. For those who crave speed, the Igls-Pazeill ski jump or the Axamer Lizum mountain coaster will leave you breathless.

** **

Alpine Charm & Culture

** **

Tirol’s cities and villages are steeped in tradition, blending rustic charm with modern flair. Stroll through the medieval streets of Innsbruck, where the Goldenes Dachl glitters under the sun, or explore the fairy-tale beauty of Swovoda in the Ötztal. Don’t miss the chance to taste Tirol’s culinary delights—savory Tiroler Gröstl, fluffy Kaiserschmarrn, or a hearty Kaspressknödel with fresh mountain herbs.

** **

Relax & Unwind

** **

After a day of exploration, recharge in one of Tirol’s luxurious wellness retreats. Soak in the thermal springs of Längenfeld or indulge in a spa day at the Alpina Spa in St. Anton am Arlberg. For a taste of the great outdoors, unwind in a cozy Hütte with panoramic views of the Karwendel or Stubaier Alpen.

** **

Year-Round Magic

** **

Tirol is a destination for all seasons. In winter, glide down the slopes of Stubaier Gletscher or Sölden, where the sun shines even in December. When spring arrives, hike through blooming meadows in the Lechtal or Pitztal. Summer brings hiking trails galore, from the Fernpass to the Reschenpass, while autumn paints the Zillertal and Wipptal in fiery hues.

** **

Your Lex&Mex Experience

** **

Let us craft your perfect Tirol adventure—whether it’s a multi-day trek, a family-friendly ski holiday, or a romantic getaway. Our local experts know the hidden gems, from the best Apfelstrudel in Imst to the most scenic Almhütten in the Ötztal. Ready to explore?
